source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of types of testing (PDF 63).

items: Unit testing: code ke chhote hisse (jaise functions ya classes) alag alag, akele (in isolation) test karna. Python ka unittest module is ke liye aam hai.
Integration testing: dekhna ke code ke alag alag hisse mil kar theek kaam karte hain.
Functional testing: user ki nazar se check karna ke software expectations (umeedon) ke mutabiq chalta hai.

Regression testing: check karna ke nayi changes (tabdeeliyon) ne pehle se chalta kaam kharab nahi kiya. Misaal: neeche unittest module se add function test kiya gaya hai, alag alag inputs de kar, ta ke pakka ho ke function sahi results deta hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import unittest": Python ka built-in testing module program mein laata hai.
"def add (a , b) :" aur "return a + b": yeh woh function hai jise test karna hai; dono numbers ka jor wapas karta hai.
"class TestMathOperations(unittest.TestCase):": tests ki class banti hai jo unittest.TestCase se inherit karti hai (wirasat mein us ke methods le leti hai), jaise assertEqual.
"def test_add(self):": method ka naam test_ se shuru hota hai, is liye unittest isay khud dhoond kar test ki tarah chalata hai.
"self.assertEqual(add(2, 3), 5)": check karta hai ke add(2, 3) ka jawab 5 hai; na ho to test fail ho jata hai.
"self.assertEqual(add(-1, 1), 0)": negative number ke saath doosra check: -1 + 1 = 0.
"if __name__ == '__main__':" aur "unittest.main()": file seedhi chalayi jaye to unittest.main() saare tests chala kar nateeja (result) dikhata hai.
Output: pehle ek dot (.) aata hai, yani ek test pass hua; phir dashes ki line, "Ran 1 test in 0.000s" aur aakhir mein "OK", kyunke dono checks sahi nikle. Dono assertEqual ek hi method mein hain, is liye ginti 1 test hai. Waqt (0.000s) har computer par thora alag ho sakta hai.
Khud try karein: pehle check mein 5 ki jagah 6 likh kar Run karein: ab dot ki jagah F aayega, FAIL ki tafseel (detail) aayegi aur aakhir mein "FAILED (failures=1)".

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yeh code bina indentation ke chhapti hai: def test_add class ke andar, assertEqual wali lines def ke andar, aur unittest.main() if ke andar indented honi chahiyein (warna IndentationError). '__main__' ke quotes bhi tirchhe (’ ’) chhape hain; seedhe quotes chahiyein.

blocks.explanation: Ke add(2, 3) bilkul 5 wapas kare; warna test fail ho kar farq batata hai.

items: unittest: assertEqual(asal result, expected result (jo aana chahiye)).
